taglines: It's Saturday. The deploy is still running. The deploy has been running since Thursday. The deploy has a family now.
You opened the laptop 'just to check one thing' on a Saturday morning. The thing has spawned four other things. Classic.
The AI said 'I'll handle that.' The AI handled it. You now have a new problem that didn't exist in any previous timeline.
Weekend project status: three tabs open, one npm install hanging, a README with just a title, and unearned confidence.
The standup is on Monday. This is not the standup. This is you, alone, arguing with a compiler about what 'done' means.
Coffee: consumed. Intentions: stated. Actual output: two variable renames and a very long README no one will read.
Something works and you don't know why. Something else doesn't work and you also don't know why. Same energy. Same skill.
The scope crept so far it's in a different zip code. The deadline didn't move. The budget didn't move. Only you moved, and not in a good direction.
